coaching.headline: A one-tower-to-eight loss built on fights taken without five bodies, then Orb Prime falling at 25.6 with four of us dead from the fight at 24.4.
coaching.team: We lost this by fighting without five bodies. First blood went to Serath on Greystone at 2.2, and the early game still held: the river fight at 7.7 went 3-2 and we took Mini Prime at 10. From 12 on, every fight we lost before the last one was taken with teammates alive and no kill or death credited to them. Boris and Iggy & Scorch died 0-2 to Dekker and Serath at 12, and Fangtooth fell at 12.6. At 16.9 Maco, Boris and Kira went 0-3 into Dekker and Riktor with Greystone and Iggy & Scorch both alive and neither credited with a kill or death in it; the outer tower and a second Fangtooth followed. We won the fight at 22.2, 3-1, and they answered by taking Fangtooth across the map. The fight at their outer tower at 24.4, lost 1-4 with Greystone alive and ahead in lane and no kill or death credited to him, left Kira, Maco, Boris and Iggy & Scorch dead, and Orb Prime fell at 25.6 with four of us down. The 5v5 at 26.3, lost 1-5, ended it. They out-warded us 39 to 26. Next game: no fight until all five are standing in it.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: Three lost fights became three structures. The fight at 16.9, lost 0-3 with two of us alive and uncredited in it, gave up the outer tower and a Fangtooth. The fight at 24.4, lost 1-4 with four of us dying, gave up Orb Prime at 25.6. The 5v5 at 26.3, lost 1-5, gave up the base.
coaching.whatWorked: Kira's late window: four kills in under two minutes on Dekker, Riktor, Serath and Aurora, and the fight at 22.2 won 3-1 off the back of it.

perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Maco healed but was in few of the kills: 1 kill and 5 assists on 19 team kills, 16,123 healing, 16,119 damage mitigated. The solo death to Riktor at 10 was the one free kill; the other three came inside fights the team lost. 8 wards to Riktor's 16.
perPlayer.16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Kira won the late fight. Four kills in under two minutes made the fight at 22.2 a 3-1 win. The fight at 18.5 went 4v5 with Greystone dead and Kira alive and ahead in lane with no kill or death credited in it; a shove-and-rotate there changes the count. Three items by minute 27, none from the core, and four deaths.
perPlayer.6317c922-6a5c-4287-a2a3-24a24aa25bfa: Greystone was caught alone three times. First blood to Serath at 2.2, then solo deaths to Aurora and Serath inside two minutes before minute 20. Alive and ahead in lane with no kill or death credited in the fight at 16.9, lost 0-3, or the one at 24.4, lost 1-4; a shove-and-rotate there changes the count. The lane was fine: three kills on Aurora, the only magic resist.
perPlayer.dd5a8477-4c5d-4f67-a8af-66eea1569e4f: Boris fought every fight and lost the map. 8 kills, 9 deaths, most on the roster, 1 ward placed. Caught alone by Serath at 20.3 with the outer tower falling at 21.7. Two earlier deaths each sat a minute before a Fangtooth. Their side put 55,064 damage into structures to our 7,352, and Boris's 5,943 was most of ours: they took structures while Boris took fights.
perPlayer.495fb001-0cda-4f3b-b23a-24a4859af934: Mid was ours on paper all game and produced a donated lane: 0 kills, 7 deaths, 2 items at 27 minutes, 11,018 hero damage. Alive and ahead in lane with no kill or death credited in the fight at 16.9, lost 0-3; a shove-and-rotate there changes the count. Deaths at 12.1 and 23.1 each came right before an enemy Fangtooth. Lowest grade on the roster.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.text: Four kills between 21.7 and 23.4 around the fight at 22.2, won 3-1, but was alive in a winning lane while the fight at 18.5 went 4v5.

6317c922-6a5c-4287-a2a3-24a24aa25bfa.text: Three solo deaths before minute 20 and two fights alive with no kill or death credited outweigh three kills on Aurora.

dd5a8477-4c5d-4f67-a8af-66eea1569e4f.text: Nine deaths and one ward in a jungle Serath ran; their side put 55,064 into structures to our 7,352.

495fb001-0cda-4f3b-b23a-24a4859af934.text: Zero kills, seven deaths and two items from a favored mid lane is a donated lane, not a lost one.

16.9.call: Maco, Boris and Kira went 0-3 into Dekker and Riktor with Greystone and Iggy & Scorch alive and neither credited in it. The call: nobody takes that fight until five are there, or concede it. It cost the outer tower and Fangtooth.

24.4.call: Five alive, and the fight at their outer tower still went 1-4 with Greystone ahead in lane and no kill or death credited in it. Orb Prime then fell at 25.6 with Kira, Maco, Boris and Iggy & Scorch dead from it. The call: Greystone shoves and walks before this starts, or the four back off.

26.3.call: Down on towers and level on items at 14 each, the 5v5 at 26.3 was the only fight left; it went 1-5 and the base followed. The game was decided when Orb Prime fell at 25.6 with four of us dead.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: The build was self-sustain and cooldowns (Hexbound Bracers, Everbloom, Timewarp) with no magic resist against a three-magic comp. The fight at 16.9, lost 0-3 to Dekker and Riktor, is where the core's Enra's Blessing, a shield on an ally the moment they are locked down, earns its slot.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: The engine does not model support Eternals; the field runs Exarch on Maco.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Crit and attack speed (Vanquisher, Onixian Quiver, Scattershot) instead of the Solaris, Ashbringer, Imperator core traded away Solaris's empowered heal-back hit and Ashbringer's cooldown refunds for raw hits. The four kills around 22.2 show the damage arrived; the deaths to Serath and Dekker after 24 show the sustain did not.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Vermis pays out on every third straight basic attack on the same hero, which fits Kira's stack-and-shred kit against a frontline of Aurora and Riktor, and trades away the burst a Demiurge item build would give.

6317c922-6a5c-4287-a2a3-24a24aa25bfa.build: On the Overlord, Rapture, Aegis Of Agawar core with Catalytic Drive as the roster's only magic resist against Aurora's 36,529 magic damage; nothing to teach here.
6317c922-6a5c-4287-a2a3-24a24aa25bfa.eternal: Thraex marks whoever Greystone last hit for more damage dealt and less taken, a duelist fit for an offlane that killed Aurora three times, at the cost of Krix's raw health for the teamfight frontline job.

dd5a8477-4c5d-4f67-a8af-66eea1569e4f.build: Tainted Blade in Basilisk's slot gave the team its only anti-heal against Riktor; the gap that showed was magic resist, none of it, while taking 50,669 damage from a three-magic comp.
dd5a8477-4c5d-4f67-a8af-66eea1569e4f.eternal: Vermis rewards three straight basic attacks on one target, which fits a jungler whose whole kit is grabbing one pick and holding it, and gives up the extra health a Krix Boris would bring into a three-magic comp.

495fb001-0cda-4f3b-b23a-24a4859af934.build: Two items in 27 minutes is the whole build read: the missing Entropy never had gold behind it because the lane's 0 kills and 7 deaths fed Wraith, Serath and Dekker instead.
495fb001-0cda-4f3b-b23a-24a4859af934.eternal: Vesh turns every ability hit into a burn over time, the fit for a mage whose kit is layered fire zones, and it only pays when the lane produces hits, which 0 kills and 7 deaths did not.

threats: Chain-CC risk (3 hard-CC abilities, ~2.5s of lockdown): Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Heal-stacking: Riktor. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 1 item of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Serath. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Maco) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult

enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Ascend dive → Heaven's Fury multi-strike → Chastise slow → Heresy form ult, resets on takedowns
enemyKits.winCondition: dive the backline and snowball Heresy resets
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates her dive angle
enemyKits.playAgainst: peel the backline — deny the first kill and her resets dry up

enemyKits.combo: Peekaboo! mark+slow → Knock, Knock! sniper → Back It Up! displacement ult

fedBy: Fallen Grace (passive): Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s. Upon touching it, Serath activates Heresy at no cost and reduces her current basic ability cooldowns by 65%.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 927 hero damage a minute, more than 75% of Serath jungle players this patch (19% of the team's). The damage came from Sky Splitter, Storm Breaker, Tainted Rounds.
Heresy at rank 3: 85s base, about 77.3s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Spectra 10.
12 takedowns (8 kills, 4 assists) fed: Fallen Grace (passive).
Serath dealt 25,016 hero damage, 19% of their team's, with +122 physical power from items.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Storm Breaker (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Release a bolt of lightning that chains to 7 Targets.
Tainted Rounds (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.
Eviscerator (crest): Gain 20% Attack Speed and 8% Omnivamp for 6s. Empower your Basic Attacks to deal (+10%) Damage On-Hit for 6s.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Tainted Rounds: On Successful Basic Attacks: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s. Deal (+10%) (+20%) Damage On-Hit. Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.; 10,305 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 6 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Storm Breaker, Tainted Rounds, Spectra, Eviscerator, Weald.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Eviscerator.
The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider) sits on the same trigger as the items (every basic attack set off), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 4 players Serath killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Boris. We killed Serath 3 times.

Copy it? Weald (Forage + Wind-Rider): 50.7% in 582 Serath jungle games, level with the hero's 49.8%; this 3-item core: 52.9% in 136 games, level with the 53% of that hero-role's cores. A standard setup: what made it work was this game, not a secret build.

wraith.loadout: Satariel (Demonic Bargain + Broken Wings), augment Sniper's Bounty, crest Witchstalker
fedBy: Nightfall (Dusk Reaver): On Takedown: Gain a 200-400 Shield for 3.5s.• Shield size increases with Level.

Satariel (Eternal): Takedowns grant a stack of Fearless (max 6). Max Health is reduced by 6% (+6.5% melee / +7.5% ranged per Fearless), and you gain 4% (+4% per Fearless) increased Physical Power, Magical Power and Attack Speed. Fearless stacks are lost on death.
lines: Back It Up! at rank 3: 95s base, about 68.8s by the end (28% shorter) from 38 ability haste: Alternata 10, Tainted Trident 10, Infernum 10, Witchstalker 8.
9 takedowns (5 kills, 4 assists) fed: Nightfall (Dusk Reaver), Satariel (Eternal).
Their build heals off damage: anti-heal (the Tainted items) cuts it.
Wraith dealt 18,694 hero damage, 15% of their team's, with +202 physical power from items.

Penetration: Alternata 12, Tainted Trident 11, Infernum 9, Nightfall 10, Witchstalker 5; against Iggy & Scorch (level 15: about 84 physical armor, 37 after penetration; took 18,193 physical damage from heroes, 62% of all hero damage they took) and Boris (level 15: about 94 physical armor, 47 after penetration; took 8,790 physical damage from heroes, 34% of all hero damage they took) that is about 34% and 32% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Alternata (item): Your Alternate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Unit: Deal 3 (+6%)% additional Damage.
Infernum (item): Damaging Abilities and Basic Attacks: Apply stacks of Kindling to Enemy Units for 2.5s. At 4 stacks, ignite them. Deals 4 (+1.5%)% of their Max Health as Damage over 2s.
Infernum (item): Based on Enemy Bonus Armor: For each point, Cinder deals 0.8% more Damage.
Nightfall (item): Abilities Heal for 6% of damage dealt to Heroes.
Witchstalker (crest): Cleanse all Debuffs. Empower your next Damage Instance within 8s. Deal 4% Target Max Health as Damage. Double the Damage if a Debuff is Cleansed. Heal equal to the Damage dealt.

Sustain: 8% omnivamp; Tainted Trident: On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.; Nightfall: Abilities Heal for 6% of damage dealt to Heroes.; Nightfall: On Takedown: Gain a 200-400 Shield for 3.5s. Shield size increases with Level.; Witchstalker: Cleanse all Debuffs. Empower your next Damage Instance within 8s. Deal 4% Target Max Health as Damage. Double the Damage if a Debuff is Cleansed. Heal equal to the Damage dealt.; 698 healing recorded.

Lesson: Wraith's penetration cut through: Iggy & Scorch took about 34% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 15 their armor was about 84, about 37 after 47 flat penetration).
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Trident, Nightfall, Witchstalker.
Stack (Every takedown fed): 2 effects on one trigger: Nightfall, Satariel. Each kill or assist made the next fight easier.
The Eternal was part of it: Satariel (Demonic Bargain + Broken Wings) sits on the same trigger as the items (every takedown fed), so the same hits paid out twice.
Countered? 0 of the 2 players Wraith killed built physical armor. Anti-heal on Boris. We killed Wraith 4 times.
Copy it? Satariel: 51.3% in 113 Wraith midlane games, above the hero's 46.9%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Back It Up! came back about every 69s instead of 95s by the end (28% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
